_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: John Anster (1793-1867). Goethe's Faust, part 1, in verse (1835). PD. A second witness beside Bayard Taylor's and Hayward's. Added 2026-10-03 by lane C (round 7) under the coordinator's standing instruction; Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted in the relay burst.
